summary: Phase 1A Session B Commit 3 (3a/3b/3c) FRONTEND verification PASS. All 12 flows from the review request behave as specified at 390x844 and 375x667. Headless suites are green per agent-to-agent context and were not re-run (not in testing scope). Highlights: (3a) Fresh save shows identity-prompt; identity-skip-button saves a random player+team pair from Appendix A (observed 'Mittu' / 'City Spinners'); reload preserves them exactly. Home: status-coins=300, status-fans=0, status-form='–'; menu-career label='START CAREER' routes to career-screen via router.replace; menu-profile → profile-screen; menu-quick-match → quickplay-screen. Destination bar wooden style with nav-home/nav-career/nav-team/nav-locker/nav-training, only one destination mounted at a time (replace nav). Locker tap shows 'Locker — coming soon' toast (locker-coming-soon) and stays on current screen; toast auto-dismisses after ~1.6s. Quick Play: toggle-doubles/toggle-singles correctly show/hide qp-partner; difficulty-rookie/club/pro route to match-screen; back-button returns to home. (3b) Career: career-stage='Community Cup', next-match-number='Match 1 of 10', rival-name='Bandra Gully Smashers', court-name='Bandra Garden', reward-coins='+100', reward-fans='+20'; play-match visible above the fold on BOTH 390x844 (bottom y=443) and 375x667 (bottom y=443); view-in-team routes to team-screen with roster-anli highlighted (gold border + cream backdrop). Team: team-coins=300, roster shows only roster-anli with status-anli=ACTIVE on a fresh save (discoveredPartners correctly filters). Training: training-partner-name='Anli', training-left='2 of 2 sessions left today', scrimmage-left='3 of 3 sessions left today'; training-change opens training-picker with pick-anli. Header overlays: header-inbox → inbox-overlay with inbox-empty text 'No messages yet. Play Career matches to hear from Mumbai.'; header-stats → stats-overlay with stats-body (Career wins/losses/win rate/longest rally/fans/form) and stats-history-link that opens /history; overlay-close dismisses. (3c) Painted scoreboard inside the court art is visible via score-display with top-row = player's team code and bottom-row = rival code. Verified bottom codes across all four modes: Career Match 1 → ' BGS 0 ' (Bandra Gully Smashers), Quick Play CLUB → ' RIV 0 ', Training → ' DRL 0 ', Scrimmage → ' SPR 0 ', Dev Mumbai Local court → ' RIV 0 ' with the distinct Mumbai Local painted background (train station skyline). Top row shows serve marker '●' and server number '2' in doubles (e.g. '●CIT02' where CIT = City Spinners). RALLY column present. pause-button opens pause-overlay, resume-button resumes, quit-button returns to the launching screen (career/training/quickplay). Old floating score panel and rally pill are not visible — scoreboard is now solely inside the painted board. No console errors, no pageerror, no red-box across all flows.

action_items: No action required for Commit 3 (3a/3b/3c) scope — every testID from the review request is wired, every value and layout check passes, scoreboard team codes BGS/RIV/DRL/SPR all appear in the correct bottom row for the correct mode, destination bar switches with replace (only one destination mounted at a time), Locker toast appears and stays on current screen, Career PLAY MATCH is above the fold at both 390x844 and 375x667, Mumbai Local court launches via the DEV button with a distinct painted background.

Optional carryover (non-blocking, unchanged for 9+ iterations): migrate react-native-skia SkPath mutators to Skia.PathBuilder.Make(); migrate pointerEvents prop to style.pointerEvents; migrate shadow*/textShadow* props to boxShadow/textShadow on web.
Reminder from review request: Session C work (reward credit, signing spend, career clearing, training counters decrementing) is intentionally not wired yet and was NOT reported as a bug.
critical_code_review_comments: _layout.tsx — Stack with animation:'none' on index/career/team/training is exactly what the brief requires (replace nav, no cross-fade, only one destination mounted at a time). Verified empirically: screen swaps happen instantly with no overlap of DestinationBar underline.

DestinationBar.tsx — Locker is correctly treated as a flat tab (no path, locked state in accessibility), the toast is 'position:absolute' above the bar with pointerEvents=none so it does not swallow the next tap, auto-dismiss via setTimeout(1600). Android hardwareBackPress is routed to router.replace('/') for non-home destinations which matches the one-level nav model.

career.tsx — reward preview is computed from economyConfig.careerRewardPreview and the coinParts/fanParts are rendered in the subtext ('100 base + 20 Mumbai'-style display), not hardcoded. The 10-node progress strip is grouped 3/3/4 (community/local/district) with lock icon + dimmed color for groups whose first match has enabled=false, star markers at round==='FINAL' nodes (3/6/10), and transform:scale(1.15)+gold border for the current node — matches the brief exactly.

team.tsx — roster is strictly discoveredPartners(save) so a fresh save shows only Anli with status-anli=ACTIVE. The 'highlight' param from view-in-team correctly scrolls into view via rowHi style with gold border.

training.tsx — training-left and scrimmage-left are derived from meta.dailyUsage(Date.now()) and TRAINING_MODES.*.dailyCap, showing '2 of 2' / '3 of 3' on a fresh save. The picker lists only signed partners (PARTNER_IDS.filter(signed)), which is the correct roster rule.

match.tsx scoreboard — row(code, score, serving, rowTestID) renders '● ' + code + ' ' + score + (doubles ? ' ' + serverNumber : '') with testIDs score-row-top / score-row-bottom. teamCode(identity.teamName, rivalCode) correctly resolves to a 3-letter code that differs from the rival (observed CIT vs RIV / BGS / DRL / SPR). RALLY column is present and the old floating score panel + rally pill have been removed as specified.

HeaderActions.tsx — Overlay uses react-native Modal with transparent + animationType='none' which matches the 'no animation' brief; inbox marks snapshot-of-unread read on open via meta.markInboxRead(unreadIds) — a safe one-shot effect.

success_rate.frontend: 100% — 12/12 review-request flows PASS at both 390x844 and 375x667, zero console errors / zero pageerror across the full run
